Bill.BriefDescription: Reviewing project cost estimates for transportation projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to reviewing project cost estimates fortransportation projects; creating a new section; and making anappropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The joint transportation committee shallconduct an audit and review of the department of transportation'sproject cost estimating processes for projects funded by the 2003nickel account and the 2005 transportation partnership account. Thereview may include the use of an expert review panel to determine ifbest practices are being used to estimate project costs. The reviewmust include an analysis of the accuracy of previous cost estimatescompared to actual costs for completed projects, and current projectcost estimates compared to original estimates for projects that are notyet completed. The joint transportation committee shall report itsfindings and recommendations to the house of representatives and senatetransportation committees by December 1, 2007.

The sum of one hundred fifty thousand p. 1 HB 1718dollars, or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated forthe biennium ending June 30, 2009, from the motor vehicle fund to thejoint transportation committee for the purposes of this act.
